definitions.core: Explicit gas-path mechanism, component damage/performance, symptoms tied to it, or associated inspection/mitigation; applies to the audited passage only.
definitions.directly_related: Controls, measurement, fuel supply, applicability or observed symptoms directly needed to interpret a gas-path problem, without proving a gas-path mechanism.
definitions.auxiliary: Engine-health, mechanical reliability, general principles or document governance background outside the core mechanism.
definitions.distractor: Source content outside the turbine gas-path scope that can confuse retrieval; retain separately for robustness.
definitions.needs_review: Unreviewed scope, mixed/ambiguous content, or structure/figure quality needing independent verification.

publication: Source offsets/hashes and audit reasons only; no canonical/full raw text redistributed.
source_selection: Use core/directly-related verified spans for primary tasks; auxiliary and distractors separately; needs_review isolated.
next_review: Independent source review, then source-family grouping and new task/evidence-pool review before a new frozen benchmark.
